learning_outcomes.text: Students understand the social world they live in academically.
Students grasp the relationship between society and the individual along with their own existence.
Students evaluate the individual's role within rapidly changing social relationships.
Students learn to prepare an academic assignment.
Students become proficient in basic terminology in sociology.

syllabus_topics: Methods of Sociology, methods in social research
Social phenomena, social behaviors and sociological perspective
Pioneers of Sociology: Comte, Durkheim, Weber and Marx
Globalization and new forms of society
Basic characteristics of Turkish social structure
End of term evaluation and discussion
